list.name: apparaat
list.label: Apparaat
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "agent_host", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "interface", start: -1h)

list.name: interface
list.label: Poort
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.defaultBucket, tag: "ifName", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r.agent_host == "${apparaat}", start: -1h)

panels.title: Actieve alarmen
panels.description: Alarmen die nu afgaan of bijna afgaan. Leeg betekent dat alles in orde is. De regels staan in Alerting, Alert rules.

panels.title: Doorvoer per poort
panels.description: Verkeer in en uit per poort van het gekozen apparaat. Voor de WAN-doorvoer kies je pfSense en de WAN-interface.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r.agent_host == "${apparaat}" and r.ifName =~ /^${interface:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ifHCInOctets" or r._field == "ifHCOutOctets")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))

panels.title: Poortstatus
panels.description: Laatste status per poort. Rood betekent dat de poort down is.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r._field == "ifOperStatus" and r.agent_host == "${apparaat}")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["ifName", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {ifName: "Poort", _value: "Status"})

panels.title: Pakketfouten per poort
panels.description: Nieuwe fouten per interval. Een stijgende lijn wijst op een slechte kabel of poort.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "interface" and r.agent_host == "${apparaat}" and r.ifName =~ /^${interface:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ifInErrors" or r._field == "ifOutErrors")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)

panels.title: Latency en jitter
panels.description: Gemiddelde reactietijd en de spreiding daarvan (jitter) naar de pingdoelen.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r._field == "average_response_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r._field == "standard_deviation_ms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ping" and r._field == "percent_packet_loss")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu" and r.cpu == "cpu-total" and r._field == "usage_idle")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 100.0 - r._value, _field: "cpu"}))

from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mem" and r._field == "used_percent")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: LanCache: hit en miss (bytes)
panels.description: Toont data zodra het optionele blok voor het LanCache-logboek in telegraf.conf aanstaat.

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "lancache_access" and r._field == "bytes")
  |> group(columns: ["cache_status"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
